narrative.northStar: Color Atlas — follow material through searchable clues to inspectable evidence.
narrative.overview: A light paper atlas uses folder tabs, photographs, source sheets, waveforms and film strips to explain eight architecture chapters. The design is confined to /architecture and preserves the application shell, language controls, URL state and source interactions.
keyCharacteristics: Song/Ming display typography with Sans body and controls; self-hosted subsets and explicit fallbacks.
Chalk paper, dark ink, periwinkle, pistachio and mandarin; objects and connectors explain roles and relationships.
Horizontal chapter navigation above an independently scrolling reading surface.
Five parsing modalities, local media previews, recorded retrieval examples and source-focused citations.
Light paper treatment in both application themes, with reduced-motion support.

rules.name: Architecture scope
rules.body: Keep the new visual system within /architecture. Preserve the conversation sidebar and global controls.

rules.name: Evidence identity
rules.body: Preserve source provenance. Do not present preview media, conceptual relationships or recorded retrieval examples as live execution or a benchmark.

rules.name: Accessible navigation
rules.body: Retain localized accessible names, keyboard tabs, visible focus, citation focus return, URL query/hash state and legacy deep links.

rules.name: Current implementation
rules.body: Use the active route and color-atlas styles as the current design reference. Legacy styles and earlier proposals do not override this contract.

dos: Keep Color Atlas media, provenance, font manifests and distributed OFL notices together.
Regenerate font subsets and update hashes when source copy requires additional characters.
Check both languages, surrounding application themes, narrow containers, keyboard interactions and reduced motion for future visual changes.
Retain the detailed system map, module index and runtime references as Runtime disclosures.
donts: Do not apply the architecture palette to the whole application.
Do not replace real text, controls or source links with flattened screenshots.
Do not infer timestamped audio indexing from the local listening preview.
Do not claim new runtime or browser acceptance from this design metadata alone.
